hook.name: StocksRewardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a STOCKS/WETH pool that skims a configurable fee on every swap — buys pay a reward fee (default 1%) and sells pay a reward fee (default 3%) plus a dev fee (default 1%). Collected fees are accumulated and periodically harvested into WETH, then distributed to STOCKS holders via a RewardDistributor contract.
